module: Computes, for the Assembly Spline tool, which mesh to place at each location along the spline for each rigid component and each bridge of the molecule. Each component is a group (base mesh + variations): if isRandom, each location draws a variation according to its normalized randomWeight weights; otherwise the enabled variations are alternated in round robin. Only considers components enabled for the spline (mol.getRigidEnabled / getBridgeEnabled).
notes: The result arrays are preallocated and reused from one call to the next (indexed by mesh id): do not keep them after a new computeMeshMap call.
Bridges get numPlacements - 1 locations (a bridge links two consecutive placements).
A group with no enabled component yields a shared empty array (emptyTable): do not modify it.
The draw uses math.random (non-deterministic unless the global seed is set elsewhere).

computeMeshMap.desc: Computes the mesh maps for all rigid components and bridges of the molecule.

molecule.desc: Molecule with the rigids and bridges lists (each entry: mesh, variations, isRandom, randomWeight).

numPlacements.desc: Number of locations along the spline.

spline.desc: Assembly spline (for the enabled/disabled state of components).

returns.desc: rigidMaps: for each rigid (same index as molecule.rigids), array of meshPath per location.
bridgeMaps: same for bridges, over numPlacements - 1 locations.
